transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... my family wanted me to come. I just... I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I just didn't wake up. I guess lately I've been saying I don't really need to see another winter. So... here I am.
How long have you been having these thoughts about not waking up and your family being better off without you?
I suppose it's been... about a year and a month. Ever since my bowling partner passed away. It's just been going on since then.
Have you been enjoying things you used to like during this past year?

Not really. I suppose I used to look forward to things... playing bridge, the garden. The cooking at church. Cubs games. But... I don't know. Now I mostly just sit in my chair. I just can't make myself care about any of it anymore.
Have you ever thought about how you would end your life if you decided to go through with not waking up?

I haven't... I haven't really made a plan or anything. Like I said before, it's just... I just think everyone would be better off if I didn't wake up. I just don't see the need to see another winter. That's all.
Are there any activities that you still enjoy or find pleasure in?
No... like I just said a minute ago. I don't care about any of it now. The bridge, the garden, the Cubs games... I just sit in my chair. There's nothing.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to or having trouble getting out of your chair?

I suppose. My wife says I do... she tells me I move like I'm walking through deep snow. It just... takes me so long now to get dressed. Or even cross the kitchen. I usually just give up before I do much of anything.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight over the past year?
I don't know... I don't really pay attention to the scale anymore. I haven't noticed.
Have you noticed that your clothes are looser on you than they used to be?
No... I don't think so. I mostly just stay in my pajamas or my robe these days, so... I wouldn't really know.
Have you thought about a specific way you would end your life if you decided to go through with it?

Not a specific way... no. I just... I keep thinking my wife and the kids would be better off if I just didn't wake up. I've been saying lately that I don't really need to see another winter... but I haven't figured out how. That's about it.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than you used to?

I suppose so... my wife tells me I move like I'm walking through deep snow. I don't really know, but... just getting dressed or trying to cross the kitchen... it takes so long now. I usually just give up before I've done much of anything.
Are there any small things that still give you pleasure?

No. Not really. I used to... I liked playing bridge. And the garden. Used to help with the cooking at church, sometimes went to Cubs games... but now I just... sit in my chair. I can't seem to make myself care about any of it anymore.
Do you feel like you're worse now than you were a few months ago?
I don't know. I guess... it's just been a steady decline. I don't really keep track of the months. It's all just... bad.
Do you feel like you're moving more slowly than usual most of the time?

I thought I just... I already said that. My wife says it's like I'm walking through deep snow. I don't know about most of the time, but... yeah. Getting dressed, crossing the kitchen... it just takes too long. I usually just stop trying.
Do you feel like you're resting or sleeping more than you used to?
I don't know. I don't... I don't think I sleep more. I just sit in the chair. I wouldn't really call it resting. I'm just... there.
Do you feel like you're moving slowly most of the time?
I... we just talked about this. I told you what my wife said. About the snow. It's... it's just hard to move. I try to get dressed, and it just takes so much out of me. I end up just stopping.
Are there any things that you still find pleasure in or enjoy doing?

No. Not really. I used to... I used to look forward to things. Playing bridge. The garden. Cooking at the church, watching the Cubs... but no. Now I just sit in my chair. I can't... I can't make myself care about any of it.
Do you feel like you're fidgety or restless, or do you have trouble sitting still?

No. Not restless. Like I said a minute ago... it's the exact opposite. Just trying to walk across the kitchen takes so long now. I usually just give up before I've really done anything. So... no, I don't have trouble sitting still.
Do you feel like you're fidgeting or have an urge to move around?

I... didn't you just ask me that? No. I don't. Like I said... my wife says I move like I'm walking through deep snow. Just... getting dressed, or crossing the kitchen... it takes me so long. I usually just give up before I've done much of anything. So... no.
Do you feel like your feelings of sadness or emptiness are present every day?
Yes. Every day. Just... always there.
Do you feel like your sadness is worse than it was a few months ago?
I don't know... maybe. It's just... it's been bad for a while now. I haven't really kept track of when it got worse.
